about: How a story's relevance reasons and antifactors split into points. The client's parsePoints (client/src/lib/parse-points.ts) splits them for the page, and the server's mirror (server/src/services/storyContextLayout.ts) numbers the same points W1... for story context's places. Both packages' tests run every case here, so the two cannot drift apart.

cases.name: a dash list, one point per item
a list item's continuation lines join it
text before the first item is dropped
blank lines inside a list are skipped
a dash without a space starts no item
no list: blank lines split paragraphs
a paragraph keeps its line breaks
one block: each line a point
leading and trailing blank lines are dropped
